data.name: WorldChat.Subtitle
data.value: Build places, people, factions and secrets with your AI. It reads your campaign first, and nothing is saved until you apply it.

data.name: WorldChat.DmOnly
data.value: Only the DM builds the world.

data.name: WorldChat.NoAi.Title
data.value: No AI model set up yet

data.name: WorldChat.NoAi.Body
data.value: Add a text model in your AI settings to build with it. It needs to support tool calls.

data.name: WorldChat.Intro
data.value: Say what you want to add, or start from one of these. The AI looks at what your campaign already has, asks when a choice is yours, and proposes everything together for you to review.

data.name: WorldChat.Starter.settlement.Text
data.value: Build a settlement for this campaign: its districts and landmarks, the people the party will meet there, and a secret or two worth uncovering.

data.name: WorldChat.Starter.faction.Text
data.value: Create a faction for this campaign: what it wants, who leads it, a few members the party could meet, where it meets, and what it hides.

data.name: WorldChat.Starter.quest.Text
data.value: Plan a quest for the party: who asks for help and why, where it leads, who stands in the way, and the clues that point the way.

data.name: WorldChat.Starter.people.Text
data.value: Add the people the party will meet at

data.name: WorldChat.Proposal.Shared
data.value: Players can already read this, so applying it changes what they see.

data.name: WorldChat.Error.NoTools
data.value: This model can't call tools, which the world builder needs. Pick a model that supports tool calls in your AI settings.

data.name: WorldChat.Error.NoProposal
data.value: There is no proposal to apply.

data.name: WorldChat.Placeholder
data.value: What should we add to the world?

data.name: WorldChat.Proposal.Hint
data.value: Untick what you don't want. Everything is saved hidden from players; you can edit and reveal it afterwards.
